text: Guided quickstart lets users set up an account and launch a GPU instance within minutes
quote: This Quickstart will guide you through setting up your Vast.ai account and running your first instance in just a few steps.

text: Instances can be spun up in seconds at competitive marketplace prices
quote: Spin up GPU instances in seconds at competitive prices.

text: Official CLI gives full command-line control over auth, GPU search, instances, templates, volumes, and endpoints
quote: The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.

text: REST API provides full programmatic control over the platform and underlies the CLI/SDK
quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.

text: API is recommended when integrating from non-Python languages or building custom tooling
quote: Reach for the API directly when you need maximum flexibility, are integrating from a non-Python language, or are building tooling on top of Vast.

text: An agent skill lets AI coding assistants create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys, and check balances on your behalf
quote: The `vastai` agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai on your behalf — create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys, check balances, and more

text: Scoped API keys can be created with limited permissions for CI/CD or shared tooling
quote: You can also create scoped keys with limited permissions using `vastai create api-key`, useful for CI/CD or shared tooling.

text: Reserved instances offer up to 50% discount by pre-paying for GPU time, convertible from on-demand at any time
quote: Reserved instances allow you to get significant discounts (up to 50%) by pre-paying for GPU time. You can convert any on-demand instance to a reserved instance at any time.

text: Interruptible instances use a bidding system offering the lowest cost, often 50%+ cheaper than on-demand
quote: Interruptible instances use a bidding system: **Lowest cost** (often 50%+ cheaper than on-demand)

text: Autobilling can automatically top up account balance from a saved card to keep instances from being interrupted
quote: Use the autobilling feature to have the system automatically top up your account using a saved credit card when it runs low.

text: Instances only allow SSH key authentication; password login is disabled for security
quote: Vast.ai instances are configured to accept keys only - Password authentication is disabled for improved security.

text: Volumes provide persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances
quote: Volumes provide persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances.

text: Vast Serverless runs compute workloads without managing GPUs, billing only for execution time
quote: Vast Serverless is an AI infrastructure platform that lets you run compute-intensive workloads without managing GPUs, paying for execution rather than GPU rental time.

text: Overlay networks let instances on the same physical LAN share a private virtual network
quote: Vast now supports creating *overlay* networks for instances, allowing client instances on different machines on the same physical LAN to share a private, virtual LAN

text: Prebuilt or custom templates can be launched with one click to set up an instance's software environment
quote: Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click.

text: Secure Cloud machines are verified to be in certified, TIER 2/3 or ISO 27001 datacenters
quote: Secure Cloud (Datacenter): These machines are verified and confirmed to be in a certified datacenter that meets our datacenter criteria.

text: Python SDK exposes offer-search functions like vast.search_offers() for querying GPU inventory
quote: vast.search_offers(query='gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus>=4')

text: CLI search command supports filtering GPU offers by type, count, verification, ports, and sorting by performance/price
quote: vastai search offers 'gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus=1 verified=true direct_port_count>=1 rentable=true' -o 'dlperf_usd-'

text: Marketplace model creates price competition among hosts, typically beating traditional cloud pricing
quote: Vast typically delivers more competitive pricing than traditional cloud providers. The marketplace model creates natural price competition

text: Ready-made templates exist for PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, and agent workloads that can be copied and deployed
quote: PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents, and more. Real deployments you can copy.

text: Same automation operations are available via CLI or Python SDK
quote: Automate with the CLI or SDK ... `vastai` from the shell or Python. Same operations, different syntax.

text: The search page serves as the main portal for finding available machines and creating instances
quote: The search page is the main portal for finding good machines and creating instances on them.

text: SSH access enables secure login, remote command execution, and file transfer without exposing data
quote: SSH (Secure Shell) is a protocol for safely connecting to remote servers. It encrypts your connection so you can: Log in securely, Run commands remotely, Transfer files without exposing your data

text: Vast Serverless can be controlled through a dedicated Python SDK
quote: Interacting with Vast Serverless is made easy through a powerful python SDK.

text: GPU prices are set dynamically by supply and demand across 20,000+ GPUs and are programmatically queryable
quote: Prices set by supply and demand across 20,000+ GPUs. Transparent. Programmatically queryable.

text: Serverless workloads benefit from benchmark-driven autoscaling that recruits the best price-performance GPU automatically
quote: Benchmark-driven scaling: Automatic identification and recruitment of the best price-performance GPU to scale your unique workload.

text: Machine owners can list GPUs on the marketplace, set their own prices, and get paid
quote: List your machines on the marketplace, set prices, get paid.

text: Users can package their environment into a template so it can run with one click on any GPU
quote: Build a template - Package your environment so any GPU can run it with one click.
